mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the housing price index exceeding 5% signals weakening consumer balance sheets and reduced discretionary spending, which depresses earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST falls >5% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below the 5-year average signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate revenue and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS falls below its 5-year average over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in industrial production above 2% signals stronger manufacturing activity and higher corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO rises >2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS rises >2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that raises wage pressure and input costs, which reduces profit margins and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls >0.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above the 5-year average signals strengthening demand, which boosts corporate revenue and yields positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when RSAFS exceeds its 5-year average over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
